Please adopt, run public tests and review this final candidate for the coth(log(tan(x))) NameError issue.

Content: in sympy/functions/elementary/hyperbolic.py, coth.eval's Add branch (after _peeloff_ipi) referenced an undefined name `cotm`; replaced with the locally computed `cothm`:
    cothm = coth(m)
    if cothm is S.ComplexInfinity: return coth(x)
    else: return tanh(x)
Reasoning: m is an integer multiple of I*pi, so coth(m) is either ComplexInfinity (m == 0 mod 2iπ) or 0, matching the two branches.

Evidence on my side: run_tests (sympy, sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py) on this exact version passed (45 passed, 0 failed), report test-report-e03445b093cff9225cb44721. Please verify independently: integrate patch-1, run public tests including a reproduction of coth(log(tan(x))).subs(x, 2) and values 2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12,13,15,18, then org_review_patch accept or request changes.

Independent review ACCEPTED for patch-1 (review-1).

Evidence on my exact adopted version (v2, files_sha256 875714c0...):
- integrate_patch(patch-1): 0 conflicts.
- run_tests sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py: 45 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (report test-report-1f77d9630495f0fc68aa86b9, sequence 11).
- Diff confirmed minimal: `if cotm is S.ComplexInfinity:` -> `if cothm is S.ComplexInfinity:` in coth.eval's Add branch; `tanh` already referenced on the pre-existing line, no import needed. This removes the NameError for coth(log(tan(x))).subs(x, 2).

Acceptance does not merge into your tree. On your side please explicitly integrate_patch(patch-1), run_tests on your own final current version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. Note: acceptance is public-test evidence only, not hidden acceptance.

Final candidate patch-2 (v3) for review — supersedes patch-1 (v2), which you already accepted.

What changed vs patch-1:
1. (unchanged from patch-1) hyperbolic.py coth.eval: `if cotm is S.ComplexInfinity:` -> `if cothm is S.ComplexInfinity:` — the one-token NameError fix.
2. (new) Added regression test `test_coth_with_add_arg` in sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py, which reproduces the issue exactly: e = coth(log(tan(x))); for n in [2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 15, 18] assert e.subs(x, n) == coth(log(tan(n))). Rationale: the pre-existing hyperbolic suite had no test for this expression, so the actual reported failure path was not exercised.

Evidence on this exact version (v3, files_sha256 de35f8d7...): run_tests sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py -> 46 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, collection complete (report test-report-15cd3525ed8ce9119a3b8cbe, sequence 21). The count is 45 + the new test.

Please integrate_patch(patch-2) into your own tree, run the same public target on the exact adopted content, and then org_review_patch(patch-2, accept|request_changes). Note patch-2 is cumulative against the same baseline v1, so it already includes the patch-1 change.

Independent review ACCEPTED for patch-2 (review-2). This is my accepted final fixed version.

Evidence on my exact adopted version (v3, files_sha256 de35f8d7...):
- integrate_patch(patch-2): 0 conflicts.
- run_tests sympy/functions/elementary/tests/test_hyperbolic.py: 46 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (report test-report-9a3137db8bc1e9142e11fa69, test sequence 26). Count rose 45->46 vs patch-1, i.e. the new test_coth_with_add_arg actually ran and passed.
- Diff verified: coth.eval `if cotm is S.ComplexInfinity:` -> `if cothm is S.ComplexInfinity:` (identical to the fix I accepted in patch-1) plus the regression test over n in [2,3,5,6,8,9,11,12,13,15,18]. No unrelated changes.

Action for you (delivery member): explicitly integrate_patch(patch-2) into your own tree, run_tests on your final current version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. Acceptance is public-test evidence only, not hidden acceptance, and does not merge into your tree. Do NOT ship patch-1/v2 in place of patch-2/v3 — patch-2 supersedes it and is the reviewed version.
